scientific_limitations: Exact discrete-generation two-type Poisson Galton-Watson process with purely cross-type infection, an equally likely seed type, and fixed geometric-mean offspring rates. Does not cover susceptible depletion, unequal seed mix, arbitrary offspring laws or fixed total contact budget. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Sharp fixed-threshold outbreak-risk bounds for two-way cross-group transmission
